name: 0028_candidate_acceptance
sql: ALTER TABLE hiring_applications ADD COLUMN accepted_stage TEXT CHECK(accepted_stage IS NULL OR accepted_stage='accepted'); ALTER TABLE hiring_applications ADD COLUMN acceptance_evidence TEXT; CREATE TABLE hiring_acceptances(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, organization_id TEXT NOT NULL, brand_id TEXT NOT NULL, application_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, offer_id TEXT NOT NULL, offer_version INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, expected_version INTEGER NOT NULL, acceptance_evidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(acceptance_evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TRIGGER hiring_acceptances_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON hiring_acceptances BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'acceptance is immutable'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_acceptances_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hiring_acceptances BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'acceptance is immutable'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_acceptances_validate BEFORE INSERT ON hiring_acceptances BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid acceptance') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_offers o ON o.application_id=a.id AND o.tenant_id=a.organization_id AND o.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE a.id=NEW.application_id AND a.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND a.brand_id=NEW.brand_id AND COALESCE(a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)='offered' AND a.version=NEW.expected_version AND o.id=NEW.offer_id AND o.current_version=NEW.offer_version AND o.status='approved' AND json_extract(v.terms_json,'$.compensation_type')='paid' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id))); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_acceptance_columns_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF accepted_stage,acceptance_evidence ON hiring_applications WHEN OLD.accepted_stage IS NOT NEW.accepted_stage OR OLD.acceptance_evidence IS NOT NEW.acceptance_evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'controlled acceptance required') WHERE OLD.accepted_stage IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_acceptances x WHERE x.application_id=OLD.id AND x.organization_id=OLD.organization_id AND x.brand_id=OLD.brand_id AND x.expected_version=OLD.version AND x.acceptance_evidence=NEW.acceptance_evidence AND NEW.accepted_stage='accepted'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_acceptance_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON hiring_applications WHEN NEW.accepted_stage IS NOT NULL OR NEW.acceptance_evidence IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'controlled acceptance required'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_acceptance_commit AFTER INSERT ON hiring_acceptances BEGIN UPDATE hiring_applications SET accepted_stage='accepted',acceptance_evidence=NEW.acceptance_evidence,version=version+1,updated_at=NEW.created_at WHERE id=NEW.application_id; INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) VALUES(NEW.operation_id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.brand_id,NEW.application_id,'offered','accepted',NEW.expected_version+1,NEW.acceptance_evidence,NEW.actor_user_id,NEW.created_at); INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,redacted_summary) VALUES(NEW.operation_id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.brand_id,NEW.application_id,'application.accepted',NEW.actor_user_id,NEW.operation_id,NEW.created_at,'Candidate acceptance recorded'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_accepted_decision_guard BEFORE INSERT ON hiring_decisions WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=NEW.application_id AND accepted_stage='accepted') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'accepted is terminal'); END; CREATE TRIGGER hiring_accepted_dispatch_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF delivery_state ON hiring_outbox WHEN NEW.delivery_state IN ('pending','sending') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=NEW.application_id AND accepted_stage='accepted') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'accepted application is terminal'); END;
